blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III underscored on Thursday the efforts of the House of Representatives to turn bamboo into a sustainable source of livelihood and economic activity. Dy spoke about this before developing partners and technical experts of the bamboo industry during the “Building the Future with Bamboo” program at the Asian Development Bank headquarters in Mandaluyong City. Dy highlighted the approval of the House Committee on Agriculture and Food of a substitute bill aiming to strengthen the country’s bamboo industry by recognizing bamboo as both a high-value and industrial crop and establishing a national framework linking farmers […]...
